title: VERIFY: Signup flow with migration works end-to-end
description: Browser verification - test the complete signup flow including anonymous progress migration.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clear all localStorage and start fresh
As anonymous user, practice a song and mark words as learned
Verify localStorage has songscript_visitor_id with data
Enter email, display name, ensure 'Bring progress' checkbox is checked
Verify migration success (check console or success message)
Navigate to dashboard - verify progress is preserved
Check Convex dashboard - data has userId, not visitorId

notes:
BROWSER VERIFICATION REQUIRED.

TEMPMAIL MCP - For signup testing:
- Use `create_email` to get a disposable email address
- Fill signup form with the temp email
- Use `get_messages` to check inbox for magic link
- Use `get_message_detail` to read the magic link email
- Extract the verify URL and navigate to it

Cleanup test users with:
- npx convex run oneTimeMigration:deleteTestUserByEmail '{"email": "<temp-email>"}'
